entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Feature: Complete first-run setup and Windows distribution
Feature: Guide new instances through account claiming and show the claimed account details and local address
Feature: Add a self-contained Windows installer with service cleanup, optional tray startup, and post-install launch choices
Feature: Keep installed runtime data separate from the source checkout so reinstalls do not reuse repository data
Feature: Improve live media and watch-state updates across dashboard, history, and sync surfaces
Feature: Add a packaged demo catalog and refresh the public documentation experience
